mapper.select: SELECT w.w_num, w.u_member_id, w.pd_id, p.pd_id AS p_pd_id, p.pd_name AS p_pd_name, p.pd_price AS p_pd_price, p.pd_image_url AS p_pd_image_url, p.pd_discount_rate AS p_pd_discount_rate, p.pd_stock AS p_pd_stock FROM wish_tbl w JOIN product_tbl p ON p.pd_id = w.pd_id WHERE w.u_member_id = #{value} ORDER BY w.w_num DESC
SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM wish_tbl WHERE pd_id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wish_tbl (w_num, u_member_id, pd_id) VALUES(WISH_TBL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{u_member_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{pd_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC})
